events.title: BIZNET Breakfast Networking
events.description: SABCO's monthly business breakfast networking session. Open to members and guests. Mix of professionals from across the SA community in UAE.

events.title: BIG Inter-Council Networking Night
events.description: Cross-industry networking night bringing together multiple business councils. Hosted at SO/ Uptown Dubai. Smart casual dress.

events.title: DHL GoTrade E-Commerce Workshop
events.description: Workshop on e-commerce opportunities for SA businesses trading into the UAE and the region. Co-hosted by DHL GoTrade.

events.title: South African Braai Day UAE
events.description: National Braai Day celebrated in Dubai. Annual gathering of the SA community — boerewors, sosaties, live music and community spirit. One of the biggest SA events on the UAE calendar.

events.title: SABCO Annual Golf Day & Dinner
events.description: SABCO's flagship annual golf day at The Els Club (designed by SA golfing legend Ernie Els). Full-day event followed by gala dinner. Corporate tables available.

events.title: Inter-Africa Council Event
events.description: Pan-African business council event in Abu Dhabi. Strong SA representation. Good opportunity to connect with the broader African professional community in UAE.
